fields.headline: Evacuation order for Zones C-1, C-2 and C-3: leave now

zones.notes: Mill Creek Care Home is being moved by ambulance bus.

fields.action: Leave now. Take people, pets and medications. Do not wait for a second notice.
fields.routes: Use Canyon Road south to Highway 9. Contraflow is not in effect.
fields.shelters: People: Calloway High School gym (open). Large animals: County Fairgrounds, Gate B.
fields.accessNeeds: Call 555-0170 for a ride; deputies are checking known addresses.
fields.definitions: In Calloway County an evacuation order means leave immediately; an evacuation warning means be ready to leave.

fields.headline: Evacuation warning for Zones C-4 and C-5: be ready to leave
fields.action: Get ready to leave. Pack people, pets and medications, fill your vehicle with fuel and listen for an order.
fields.routes: Plan two ways out; Canyon Road may close.
fields.shelters: Calloway High School gym is open.
fields.accessNeeds: If you need help to leave, call 555-0170 now.

fields.headline: Shelter in place for Zone H-2 (Calloway Regional Hospital campus)

zones.area: Calloway Regional Hospital campus and the medical office park
zones.notes: Doors closed, ventilation set to recirculate.

fields.action: Stay inside. Close doors and windows. Stay away from windows. Staff will direct visitors.
fields.routes: Do not drive toward the campus; Hospital Drive is closed.
fields.accessNeeds: Patients are kept in place under the hospital plan.
fields.definitions: In Calloway County shelter in place means stay inside a building and wait for instructions.

fields.headline: All clear for Zone C-4
fields.action: The evacuation warning for Zone C-4 has ended. Normal activity may resume.
fields.shelters: Calloway High School gym closes at noon.

fields.headline: Re-entry opens for Zones C-1 and C-2 at 8 AM

zones.notes: Escort required for the last 2 miles.
Check gas and electric before use.

fields.action: Residents with photo ID or a utility bill may return. Expect no power or water in some homes, and watch for hot spots and fallen trees.
fields.routes: Enter by Canyon Road from the south only.
fields.shelters: The shelter stays open for residents who cannot return.
fields.accessNeeds: Call 555-0170 for help with a return.
fields.reentryRules: Zone C-3 stays closed. Do not enter burned areas or move debris without protective gear.
